content: XGBoost >=2.0 supports native quantile regression via objective='reg:quantileerror' with tree_method='hist' and a quantile_alpha parameter (can be a list of quantiles e.g. [0.1,0.5,0.9] trained as one multi-output booster). Practical prediction-interval pattern: train models at low/high quantiles (e.g. 0.1/0.9 for an 80% CI) alongside the point-estimate model, evaluate quality via pinball loss. This is the standard free/CPU-friendly way to get XGBoost confidence intervals without extra dependencies.
